brief: A private, offline gym and cardio diary for one person. It should feel consistent, personal and quietly athletic: the opposite of loud fitness apps full of flames and dumbbells.
criteria: Success: no fitness clichés, recognisable as an app icon and at 16 px, works in one colour, matches the app's navy/yellow and teal/sand palette.

concepts.name: Steps
concepts.idea: A slice of your training calendar: the days you logged climb like steps. Showing up is progress.
rationale: Built on the app's own yearly training grid, so logo and app feel like one thing
Avoids every gym cliché (no dumbbell, flame or flexing arm)
A 3×3 grid of one radius and one gap: crisp as a phone icon and still a staircase at 16 px

recommendation: Steps: the most ownable direction, rooted in the app's own training calendar.
next_steps: Put the new icons into the app
Use the horizontal logo in the README and on the website
